leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement union types to handle functions that return multiple possible data types
Apply type guards to narrow down union types within conditional logic
Construct functions that safely handle uncertain return values using optional chaining
Configure type assertions to override TypeScript's inference when you have more context
Initialize variables with the `unknown` type to enforce type checking before usage
Manipulate data from external APIs by applying proper typing for uncertain responses
Integrate error handling patterns that account for typed uncertain outcomes
